obligations.note: release() now returns the earlier release only if it is under one day old. A replay after 24 hours passes the approval and payee checks, which do not look at 'released' status, and calls _send_disbursement again, so a second disbursement is sent.

The register has no exception for PAY-2 or for payments.payments, so nothing permits the deviation.

summary: The change adds a one-day window to the idempotency check in release(). Replaying an instruction after 24 hours would send a second disbursement to core banking, which directly violates PAY-2. The prior PAY-2 evidence has lapsed because release() changed, and no exception covers the deviation. The CI evidence also has a provenance inconsistency: the JUnit report comes from a different host and a later date than the recorded run. The change is rejected.
